ideas.title: Uncovering the Scope of the Feeding Our Future Fraud Scheme
ideas.description: This story would investigate the full extent of the Feeding Our Future fraud scheme, including the number of people involved and the total amount of money lost.
questions: How many people were involved in the scheme?
What was the total amount of money lost?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover significant wrongdoing and result in major changes to the way that similar programs are run in the future. I will continue to track developments and follow up on leads.
